    "## 5. Feature engineering"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 12,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "metadata": {},
     "data": {
      "text/plain": "        Date  HR_price_with_tax_diesel  ...  week_sin      week_cos\n0 2013-09-23                   1.34138  ... -1.000000 -1.836970e-16\n1 2013-09-30                   1.34177  ... -0.992709  1.205367e-01\n2 2013-10-07                   1.30234  ... -0.970942  2.393157e-01\n3 2013-10-14                   1.30388  ... -0.935016  3.546049e-01\n4 2013-10-21                   1.29707  ... -0.885456  4.647232e-01\n\n[5 rows x 11 columns]"
     }
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "model_df=df[['Date','HR_price_with_tax_diesel']].copy()\n",
    "model_df['lag_1']=model_df.HR_price_with_tax_diesel.shift(1)\n",
    "model_df['lag_4']=model_df.HR_price_with_tax_diesel.shift(4)\n",
    "model_df['lag_12']=model_df.HR_price_with_tax_diesel.shift(12)\n",
    "model_df['rolling_4']=model_df.HR_price_with_tax_diesel.shift(1).rolling(4).mean()\n",
    "model_df['rolling_12']=model_df.HR_price_with_tax_diesel.shift(1).rolling(12).mean()\n",
    "model_df['volatility_12']=model_df.HR_price_with_tax_diesel.shift(1).rolling(12).std()\n",
    "model_df['time_index']=np.arange(len(model_df))\n",
    "week=model_df.Date.dt.isocalendar().week.astype(int)\n",
    "model_df['week_sin']=np.sin(2*np.pi*week/52); model_df['week_cos']=np.cos(2*np.pi*week/52)\n",
    "model_df=model_df.dropna().reset_index(drop=True); model_df.head()"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Sve značajke koriste samo informacije koje bi bile dostupne prije tjedna koji se predviđa. Time se izbjegava curenje podataka."
   ]
  },

   "cell_type": "markdown",

    "## 6. Kronološka podjela podataka"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 13,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "stream",
     "name": "stdout",
     "text": "Trening: 2013-09-23 - 2024-03-04 522\nTest: 2024-03-11 - 2026-09-07 131\n"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "features=['lag_1','lag_4','lag_12','rolling_4','rolling_12','volatility_12','time_index','week_sin','week_cos']; target='HR_price_with_tax_diesel'\n",
    "split=int(len(model_df)*.8); train=model_df.iloc[:split]; test=model_df.iloc[split:]\n",
    "X_train,y_train=train[features],train[target]; X_test,y_test=test[features],test[target]\n",
    "print('Trening:',train.Date.min().date(),'-',train.Date.max().date(),len(train))\n",
    "print('Test:',test.Date.min().date(),'-',test.Date.max().date(),len(test))"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "Nasumična podjela nije korištena jer bi model tada mogao učiti iz budućih razdoblja i davati nerealno dobre rezultate."
   ]

    "## 7. Treniranje i usporedba modela"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 14,
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "output_type": "display_data",
     "metadata": {},
     "data": {
      "text/plain": "                Model       MAE      RMSE        R2\n1  Linearna regresija  0.023467  0.035886  0.936961\n0        Naivni model  0.022634  0.036326  0.935403\n3   Gradient Boosting  0.028184  0.043877  0.905758\n2       Random Forest  0.038080  0.059200  0.828443"
     }
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "models={'Linearna regresija':LinearRegression(),'Random Forest':RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=300,max_depth=8,min_samples_leaf=3,random_state=42),'Gradient Boosting':GradientBoostingRegressor(n_estimators=150,max_depth=2,learning_rate=.04,random_state=42)}\n",
    "rows=[]; predictions={}\n",
    "naive=X_test['lag_1'].values\n",
    "rows.append({'Model':'Naivni model','MAE':mean_absolute_error(y_test,naive),'RMSE':mean_squared_error(y_test,naive)**.5,'R2':r2_score(y_test,naive)})\n",
    "for name,model in models.items():\n",
    "    model.fit(X_train,y_train); pred=model.predict(X_test); predictions[name]=pred\n",
    "    rows.append({'Model':name,'MAE':mean_absolute_error(y_test,pred),'RMSE':mean_squared_error(y_test,pred)**.5,'R2':r2_score(y_test,pred)})\n",
    "results=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values('RMSE'); results"
   ]
